latin: Cum quaeritur a Platone an ad exemplar genitum an ingenitum factus sit mundus, nihil aliud quaeritur nisi an ad animales rationes, an ad ideas intellectuales.
translation: When Plato asks whether the world was made after a generated or an ungenerated pattern, nothing else is being asked except whether it was made after animate reasons or after intelligible ideas.
